name: When is the right time to consider adding another bathroom to my home?

mainEntity.name: When is the right time to consider adding another bathroom to my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider adding a bathroom when morning routines create bottlenecks, entertaining guests disrupts private family areas, or mobility needs require accessible main-floor amenities. Homes with only one bathroom often face functionality challenges as households grow. Adding a dedicated primary ensuite or a main-level powder room resolves everyday friction, improves privacy, and addresses changing physical access needs without requiring you to move to a different property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider an addition when family morning routines clash, you lack guest facilities near common living areas, or you need main-floor accessibility.
